name: Text Logo / Wordmark
description: Typeset exact text as a logo/wordmark using a real TTF font (ComfyUI AddLabel node) — NOT diffusion. Use this whenever the output must spell an exact string (a handle, brand, wordmark) that diffusion models garble. Renders instantly, GPU-light, lands in the gallery like any generation.

text.description: Exact text to typeset (spelled precisely, e.g. 'R404')

font_color.description: Text color — PIL color name ('gold', 'white', 'red') or hex ('#D4AF37')

font.description: Font filename available on the ComfyUI node (e.g. TTNorms-Black.otf, FreeMonoBold.ttf)

text_x.description: Text left position. Default centers a 4-char string at font_size 200 on an 800px canvas

text_y.description: Text top position. Default vertically centers at font_size 200 on an 800px canvas

bg_color.description: Background color as a packed RGB int (0 = black, 16777215 = white)
